reviews.text: 当我以为世界上最好玩的塔防是猴〇〇〇球的时候，发现了这个半成品中的半成品，希望来点无尽模式和创意工坊

作者你好！这是一个很棒的游戏:steamthumbsup:，获得了我以及我父亲和我儿子的一致好评（是的，我们一家三代人都在玩，哈哈），我从最初的试玩阶段就一直在玩，正式版出来之后，我也第一时间购买了两份游戏，其中一份是为我的父亲购买的。他今年71岁，目前正在攻略普通第四大关（前面三关都已过英雄）。 这里我想提一点自己的感受，就是相比其他职业，女魔法师太弱了，我和我的家人一直认为选择她进行游戏时，游戏难度大大增加。因为塔太贵了，而强化卡片为塔带来的增益又十分有限，塔增加的额外费用与带来的收益不成正比。后期塔数量不足，强化卡片又溢出，导致卡片卡手，特别是用女魔法师游玩英雄难度时，更是举步维艰。 我建议从这几个方向来增强这个职业，一是取消该职业额外带来的造塔费用，让她可以多造塔；二是强化卡片可以重复对同一座塔使用（相同卡片增益叠加），这样可以更加体现这个职业的特点；三是让她在每回合抽牌时，可以额外抽取到更多的强化卡牌。

[b] 评价8.5/10，未来可期的塔防 [/b] 现在版本玩起来还是比较累，正反馈有，应该是说正常来讲有的，但在难度拉满后怪的数量和buff都太多太怪了，开打的时候根本看不过来，突然怪就到家门口了，突然就暴毙了，当前高难度还得微操，就很难受。 塔、角色及怪物的数量和平衡在做了在做了，所以能不能在boss战前强制加一个商店？地图还是roll的很难受，但至少现在初始不用roll了，构筑起来简单不少。 感觉的出来作者在试图将各种玩法的东拼西凑起来，就目前而言，玩法之间的联系还是太弱了，还是老问题，当前游戏数值崩溃很大一部分原因是功能太杂太多导致的，作者这几个版本明显有在修改删减，但各玩法目前也还没进一步深挖，以及把我的轮椅砍没了，愤怒喵。 [b] 但至少现在的内容和价格匹配了， [/b]也算是塔防新赛道的佼佼者了。 更新挺勤快的，希望后续能做的更好，未来可期 =================以下是旧版的评测==================== [b] 评价6.0/10，堪堪及格的塔防 [/b] 玩起来实在一般，缺乏爽感，构筑过程感受不到成就感只觉得累，缺乏别的塔防游戏一点点变强的正反馈乐趣 塔、角色及怪物的平衡做的都相当糟糕，数值非常混乱，强度差异明显，神器之间也很难说有多少搭配 目前版本游玩感受就是各种玩法的东拼西凑，之间的联系基本没有，也没有特别突出的地方，而当前游戏数值问题也正是功能太杂太多导致的，各玩法都没有深挖，比如塔只能二选一升级一次，而塔在总体数量不多的情况下还同质化严重就更糟糕了，肉鸽，但没完全肉鸽 [b] 这售价就那样吧，有更好的可以选， [/b]同时我也不是很理解测试阶段折扣越来越高是怎么回事，是觉得玩家喜欢多花钱当半成品测试员吗 更新挺勤快的，希望后续能做的更好，还是给个好评，未来可期吧

It is a game where you do nothing from moment to moment. After some time you realize you haven't been doing anything in your entire playthrough. I would appreciate stronger snapping on potential turret placements. Maybe then I would have noticed sooner just how little was actually going on with this game. The game doesn't reward intense player attention. It may be the genre itself. Because of the static nature of placing turrets, the game would have to change a lot from individual placement to demand user attention. There could be an reactive system where you would pay attention to specific enemies. I am thinking about turrets focusing on specific enemies on command depending on enemy behavior or nature. All the turrets would swap their attention to an indicated enemy. It would demand the player pay attention to enemies. The system could be more time sensitive and respond to certain enemy behaviors and stagger a larger enemy. It would demand persistent player attention. 5/10.

Emberward looks great but its appeal fades quickly due to its punishing difficulty. The balance feels off, with enemies overwhelming defenses at the early stages, leaving little room for strategy or experimentation. Progression is slow and the game sacrifices fun for frustration. Hopefully, the developer will take care of these issues before final release because the game has potential, but it is hard for me to recommend it as is at this point.

This game becomes boring and feels like a chore. Its a great single player tower defense game idea with really nice UI and visual, except you start over each level, upgrades and progression aren't noticeable to me when in effect, so its not very satisfying to win because you can never tell if you are doing good or not. Theres no intuitive sense of risk when you play, every tower you place seems to do the same thing- damage. Its not taught to you or is it clear later on whether towers counter certain mobs.
游玩13个小时的体验。 一局时间超长，最后boss一招不慎，失败后立刻从第一局重来，连改错的机会都没有，挫败感超强。 你是肉鸽游戏没错，但你不是那个一关几秒，半小时一局的那种动作肉鸽，你这一关的时间动作肉鸽估计都能打一局半了，所以失败的惩罚太大了，我是建议有个重试功能，失败后把让玩家可以自由选择是结算还是重试当前关卡比较好点。 总之暂时不太推荐游玩。

好的地方： 1. 方块不仅承载了放置防御塔和重塑路线的作用，还可以对其进行改造，往上面印什么BUFF非常讲究，策略性更深了，这点好评! 2. 因为不同地图的效果不同，场景中的内容大相径庭，所以对策需要因地制宜，而不是一个套路用到底，好评！ 3. 画风、动画、音效、BGM设计得非常不错，结合起来给人的体验非常舒服。 需要改进的地方： 1. 大部分火堆给的buff太鸡肋了，附加的dubuff >> 带来的增益，有用的没几个。 2. 场景性能还需要优化，玩到后期有点卡。 3. 开局无限次数roll塔和神器的意义不明，我都可以无限roll了，那我想要什么就有什么了，你直接给我自选开局不行吗？还浪费我的时间刷开局，高难度下不roll出特定的组合我连第一关都过不去。 4. 我认为后面需要调整一下高难可选择的道具，开局全是1X1的过渡塔，我高难连走出第一关都难，疯狂暴毙,我认为高难的数值设计是有问题的,而且问题非常大,希望做完后自己玩一下再发出来. 5. 防御塔和神器的种类看似很多，大多数都没什么用，我认为效果需要重新设计。 6. 建议加一个旋转摄像机的功能，有时候塔的模型太大，我看不到前面是否有空缺。 7. 最后一张图有一个小图非常逆天，火堆旁边一堆敌方机器，而且2回合直接解锁，你他妈的在逗我是吗？ 8. 只要上述问题没有解决，我不会推荐这款游戏。

I am well aware this is an early access game, but personally I didn't see anything special about the game. Adding the elements to the Tetris blocks was a cool mechanic, but the actual placement of the blocks seemed arbitrary and didn't really add to the gameplay for me. I think it's super cool that it's a roguelite/roguelike, this was the sole reason for my purchase.. The monsters you are killing off had decent animations, but the tower design, the maze and the overall aesthetic, were very lackluster. Maybe I will check it out again, but there are plenty of tower defense games out there that are much better, fully developed and much cheaper or free to play. Or maybe I just have early access fatigue lol. I really wish steam would add a neutral option but at this point the game is not worth $15 bucks.
bhw

There are some fundamental issues with the game design that makes it go stale very quickly. Its by no means a bad game. good for maybe 20 hours of fun, but ultimately unsatisfying. where other similar rogelikes let you build on top of erlier desitions, making for deep builds that distinguish deep runs from one another, every single round in this game feel very similar. (every stage and every run). The different characters do make for some distinction in playstyle - but thats a start bonus, so it runs on one character are still undistinguishable. Since you have to build every map from one turret to a full board, then reset - each game feels very similar. The towers you pick as you progress in a run dont do enough to change what you can do on later maps. The relics are fundamentally uninteresting, and do very little to change how you play. relics and turrets dont interact in any significant way. I dont think there is desingspace to fix theese issues. I hope the devs prove me wrong.
两年之后拿出来再玩一下，发现它有个巨大问题，不知道以前是不是这样的。 它波数很少。这对于TD是致命。6波，7波结束。。。。 举个例子，你精心规划个路线搭建积木，摆好炮塔。你别说没开始爽，你甚至没摆完，6波结束，下把，重新来吧。 或者这个游戏很适合喜欢做规划，不喜欢TD爽感的TD玩家吧。 而且它机制很多。本来是优点。需要考虑的东西增加，但加上它波数很少，反而变成缺点。

I like it, in the short term. No cardinal sins. Not riddled with homescreen ads. No politics from the creator. Lots of decent aesthetic. Lots of concepts and synergies that seem to work well together. Yet, I can name when I'm going to be overwhelmed without other options and lose every single time. Something about that synergy just doesn't seem to be Scaling into the endless matches or harder modes. I accept that there's Roguelite elements and part of that is just grinding up your "Skills". I don't mind a grindy game when the game loop is satisfying. It's not that satisfying to watch myself lose knowing there's nothing I could've done differently, only that I need to do it more times first. That doesn't feel like any kind of "skill". Not as good as Gemcraft in those ways. Nowhere as bad as Brainrot Tower Defense. Maybe if there were ... more? More upgrade paths further along? More combination bonuses to find that don't require having absolutely every single kind of tower to trigger? I don't know. It's very close, and it has its shining moments...

Game almost reached level of above medium Tower Defense, almost. I checked it during very early access and right now can see it has same enemies, towers and systems. It didn't grew. Yes we got more heroes, stages, shards, game modes but variety of main gameplay is same tiny item/tower/enemies pool. It is sad. I do not regret buying it, but after 10 hours all the fun evaporated and i have to force myself to play another run. Major problem is that it simply has weak progression system — not only you unlock all heroes too fast, but also max out technologies too fast, so it becomes a lot easier to play for no reason. Of course, there is shard system to increase difficulty, but why do we use tech to reduce difficulty and shards to increase it? It makes no sense. It lacks different music, lacks story, lacks levels (you gonna play same ones in campaign over and over). Shops are very strong, you can just route trough shops and forges and reach end very fast without actual battles. I don't know, design looks terrible. Game also has nothing unique or new about it, this is extremely average TD. In my opinion you should first play those games: - Variables 2 (more towers, more special monsters, rng levels, full control of game board, unique style); - Dungeon Warfare 3 - big and fun, unique map system; - Kingdom Rush 5 trough google play pass (only costs $1 per month) - so you get all DLC for free. - Broken Universe - just a giant of TD genre and probably the top 1 TD ever existed so far. So yeah, Emberward is not bad game, it is just not good one either. I got more TD fun from Steam World Build even tho beaten it in 6 hours.

This is a conflicting one for me. The game feels polished, its fun to play, the ui and graphics are smooth as butter. It runs well. It's got the foundation to be amazing. But it just doesn't scratch that itch for me, and I feel like it falls short of what it sets out to do. The game is a "roguelike", except the run variance is minimal at best. There are like 30 or so towers that you pick up through a run, all of which are full of character and fun to watch do their thing, and thats about where the variance ends. The mobs are all more or less the exact same, and don't call for varying strategies. The perks and other rng elements are inconsequential and I dont find myself caring to interact with them. I'll pick the first one to get the dialogue screen over with. They don't change the game much. The tetris blocks are cool but when playing you also find that they ultimately dont matter - you're going to make a zigzag path that stretches as the enemy path as far as you can every time, and the blocks in your loadout dont really ever change your ability to do so. And the game itself isn't hard enough to warrant finding the smaller synergies that may be there to eek out any extra performance - you can spam your starter tower with a half iq path built with your blocks and you will win the hardest difficulties. you can, every time, turn your brain off and go through the motions and experience virtually the same run, despite "rng" party favours existing in the background. The core is there. I feel like the game would be a 10/10 if they dropped the roguelike entirely and focused on uniqe level design and challenge building, and more enemy types to demand use of the towers. None of the roguelike elements are really working. But again, its early access. The foundation is extremely solid. I want to be able to reccomend this. Maybe they'll add some content and this will change. Because in a rare case, some extra content and tools to play with would make this game amazing. The foundation is such a solid springboard for them to throw things onto. I look forward to future updates.
Runs are very long. The difficulty is not very interesting, the elite mobs just constantly disable your towers in range which is the same thing repeated through all maps.

好更兄弟，好更 上线以来持续近两年的更新，足以看出作者对这个游戏的热爱 每一次更新中新的机制以及对细节的打磨，也体现出作者有巧思又不失老练 防御塔、火源、角色、地块、地图、道具，作者把许多简单的小机制组合在一起，形成了多变的游戏体验，这样的设计很有意思 我不是塔防高手，不过我认为游戏的高裂片难度过高，额外的怪物机制很容易让局面变得不可控。我更喜欢享受中等难度的游戏

虽然是EA我觉得看作正式游戏完全没问题，而且制作团队还在持续更新，很有诚意。造路径塔防与轻Rouge机制很有趣，特别是摆格子拉长路线然后击杀怪物的快感很足。好玩，爱玩。
难度适中，可以自己制定路线的肉鸽塔防游戏，很值得一玩
一年前玩demo时候都没这么难，当时还随便见第一大关boss。现在玩起来挫败感好重，玩了100分钟大概3把，但是第一个大关都没过。可能是我彩笔吧，但是真的玩不下去这样。。。
可以搭建地形是最大的惊喜，相当于主动规划怪物行走的路线，让游戏的自由度直线提升。各种塔的配合反而在其次了。

玩着玩着就卡死电脑，我真无语了。 后续： 似乎和另一游戏是同一原因，显示屏帧数只能60帧，然而另一款游戏我改成60帧之后就一切正常了，但这款游戏无尽模式五六波还是会卡死。 我这个配置玩王国保卫战的无尽模式从来没卡过，不知道为什么这个不仅会卡而且还会卡死，是我显存不够还是目前游戏优化不行？ 感觉游戏现在无论是怪物还是炮塔的光污染都太强了，可能就是因为这个，导致怪物一多堆在一起就会炸显存吧。 5.26后续： CPU-68°，GPU温度正常、占用率90%的情况下，使用了一张伤害增强卡片，然后就直接卡死了。 5.27后续： 关了垂直同步，CPU使用率39%、温度75°，GPU使用率65%、温度58°，额外挑战第四波再次突然卡死，30秒后电脑自动重启。目前玩其它诸如2077、生化危机、博德之门之类的大型游戏，未见此类情况发生。 6.2后续： 烤机检测之后，发现是主板出了问题，换新之后已无问题，冤枉游戏了，已改好评。游戏很有意思，希望后面能出现人形炮塔。

I'm not used to tower defense that much but I was eyeing Emberward. I tried the demo twice and couldn't completely get into it and I didn't know why. But I continued checking updates and I liked the dynamic from the devs and what I was reading. The game was still appealing to me so I decided to get it just before the 1.0, to see if I could really get into it and this time I did. Once I began to really work on placing tetrominos strategically to carve the path of the enemies and for example make long corridors with a tower or 2 in front that would spit lightning balls going through a big crowd it clicked and I finished a run. The boss was pretty epic and now I can slowly work on unlocking everything and soon trying the harder difficulties beyond normal. I can really tell there's a ton of love and work put into the title and it probably deserve its high praise.

An utterly delicious tower-defense game (build your own maze wave by wave) I haven't seen a roguelite tower defense game before - not only is there a huge library of towers (so every run begins and ends with a different grouping - you can change the loadout between stages in a run), but you must also manage your blocks. I was bummed to see there are only four locations/maps until I realized that between the different paths through the maps, randomized elements of the towers/blocks (and their buffs/mods), and unlockable heroes/fires that demand alterations in gameplay. I've only been playing for 11 hours, but I imagine I'll be here for many hours/years

This is one of those games that, even though I've completed everything in it dozens of times by now, I find myself still reinstalling it every month or two to dump another 10-15 hours in. It's a real good time waster game, and ol reliable purchase for me. My only criticism are, as of now, it only feels like Arcane and Fire towers are worth going for. Maybe a little ice to slow things down. But Ice, Electric, and Poison are underdeveloped and just don't give you enough damage. Normal feels redundant since you don't have any real reason to choose it over an element. I do adore it and think it was worth every cent. Chunk the Builder + Straigh Blocks + Arcane or Fire is GOATED.
